It has three movements - Allegro, Andante grazioso, and Alla Turca - and is composed of a variety of textures ranging from lyrical, melodic passages to virtuosic, ornate figuration. The piece is often described as having a Hungarian-influenced style and begins with a heroic theme. The Andante also stands out for its beautiful, lyrical melodies.
